clip_texts: SC-06 Unprotected left turn across oncoming traffic

Left turn on a permissive green or at an uncontrolled junction, with an oncoming lane hidden by a turning vehicle, or a
motorcycle approaching fast

One concrete scenario (seeded sample of the logical
scenario)
ODD-20 Ego speed: 38.8 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)
ODD-04 Junctions: t-junction
ODD-16 Traffic participants: motorcycle
ODD-12 Illumination: night

Speed and acceleration of the oncoming vehicle: Bound stated by
FSR-06.01, not yet fixed; the motion drawn is choreography

Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033);
choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
Safety goals at stake

SG-02 (ASIL D): Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a
collision the planned trajectory avoids

SG-06 (ASIL D): Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or
crosswalk against right of way
Pass criterion

The vehicle starts the turn only with a gap that lets the oncoming
road user pass at its assumed speed and acceleration, and stops
before the conflict area otherwise (FSR-06.01, FSR-06.02,
FSR-06.03, FSR-02.02, FSR-03.01, FM-07, AC-02)
Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
Meant to do: turns only with a safe gap
Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
Where the hazard lies: HE-06.2 Turns left in front of an oncoming vehicle
Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about
